question: Which among the following unit is used to count the speed of modern printers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PPM**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PPM **stands for **Paper per minute **which is used to **measure **the **printing speed **of **both inkjet and laser printers**.
 
• The **abbreviation **is used in **marketing to describe printer speed**.
 
• **Most printers **include a **PPM rating **for both **black and color documents**.
 
• These **speed measurements **are typically **listed in the printer's technical specifications**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cost per mille **also called **cost per thousand**, is a commonly-used measurement in **advertising**. It is the **cost an advertiser pays **for one **thousand views **or impressions of an **advertisement.**
 
• **LPM **is an abbreviation of **liters per minute **(l/min). When used in the **context of a particle counter's flow rate**, it is a measurement of the velocity at which air flows into the sample probe.
